body:
@francoischalifour Yesterday I tried to add a test for that, but it was hard to simulate user input like in real world.
In real world, we type and it adds each character at a time to input, but with testing-library, it just triggered an event with a value like '10.34'.

Today I tried their [user-event](https://testing-library.com/docs/ecosystem-user-event) package which is supposed to give a better simulation.
I ran

```js
await userEvent.type(minInput, '10.34');
```

but it triggered the following 5 events.

* `1`
* `10`
* `10.`
* `10.3`
* `10.34`

So this obviously cannot cover this regression. I think it could be only possible with real e2e test like selenium or cypress.
